description: This Kotlin source file defines a BottomSheetDialogFragment subclass that provides UI for adding or editing a recipe within the app. It manages user input for recipe details, observes view models for data, and triggers save or update actions.

classes.name: EditRecipeBottomSheet

methods.description: Inflates the layout for the bottom sheet.
